input.quote: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
input.rationale: The Agreement's only limitation of liability (p0077, at the end of the indemnity section) caps TrueLink alone at 12 months' hosting and support compensation and leaves Client's liability wholly unlimited, including under the broad Client indemnity in Section 12a. A one-way cap protecting only the Vendor is walk-away territory under LOL-CAP, and the fallback carve-outs are incomplete: only gross negligence and wilful misconduct are excluded, and indemnification and confidentiality breaches sit inside the cap. We target the fallback and make the shortest change: the existing 12-month fees basis and the clause's existing scope are retained verbatim, the cap is mutualised, and indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct are expressly outside it for both parties. Preferred-level items (USD 1,000,000 floor, "paid or payable", event-anchored 12 months, mutual consequential-damages waiver, data protection/security, fraud and IP-infringement carve-outs and the payment-obligations exclusion) are noted but not pursued at this level.

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
mappings.quote: EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.

mappings.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.

proposal.summary: Mutualise the existing 12-month fees cap and carve out indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct, leaving the clause's existing scope untouched.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We made the existing twelve-month fees cap mutual, since today only TrueLink is capped and Client's liability is unlimited, and we placed indemnification, confidentiality breaches, gross negligence and wilful misconduct outside the cap for both parties. All other wording, including the clause's existing scope, is unchanged.
